Strategy rules

Strategy: Demo Mean Reversion with Daily Trend Filter

Enter long on oversold pullback in uptrend

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN rsi_value crosses below oversold AND close is above trend
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)

Exit long on overbought

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN rsi_value crosses above overbought
THEN close the position

Exit long on protective floor

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN close drops below entry_price * 0.90
THEN close the position

Enter short on overbought spike in downtrend

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN rsi_value crosses above overbought AND close is below trend
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)

Exit short on oversold

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN rsi_value crosses below oversold
THEN close the position
